title: Undo backs a title page inserted before a clip out in one step again
goal: A person who inserts a title page in front of a recording, adds a transition, then presses Undo a few times should see the title gone and the recording back at the start. Right now four undos leave the title page on the timeline, so the insert walk fails on main.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-22 on main 93fbf8874 (change stashed) and on the pass-22 build: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/insert-a-title-before-a-clip-walk.json -> step 69 (expectClip): 1 clips are called "Title Page", and the walk expected 0; the timeline: Title Page on V1 0.00s to 4.00s; Tutorial Sample on V1 4.00s to 12.00s. Steps 61-67 are four undos after Cmd-T / Dip to black. sweep.sh status also lists it failing. Found while checking the hour-long timeline task (pass 22); not caused by it.
acceptance: Undo after inserting a title page, picking a cube, deleting it and choosing Dip to black takes the title away in the number of steps the walk expects (or the walk is corrected to the right count with the reason logged)

log.note: Reproduced on the probe: step 69 fails after 4 undos. Diagnostic walk (/tmp/diag-walk) read the state after each undo: 1 Cross dissolve (Cmd-T at step 56), 2 bare edit point (delete undone), 3 Cube, 4 Cross dissolve from the insert, 5 title gone, recording at 0:00-8:00. Cmd-T at step 28 on a join already carrying a dissolve makes no step. The app's undo is correct; the walk went stale in 500f13636 (2026-10-29) when one 'Add Transition > Dip to black' row became Cmd-T + Type (two edits). Last pass 2026-10-23, failing at step 69 since 2026-11-02. Chose to correct the walk over merging Cmd-T and the Type pick into one undo step because they are two separate edits a person makes, and Premiere undoes them separately too.

left rough: one Scripts/test.sh run failed ReframePerfTests 'A 12 megapixel frame punched in to 200%' at 5.9ms against 5.1ms while the stopwatch suites ran three at a time; alone it read 2.9ms three times and the next full run was green. First time it shows up in loop.log, so not filed; file it if it happens again. The other transition walks failing in the 11-20 sweep (a-transition-is-picked-at-the-cut, shorten-the-cut-for-a-dissolve, transition-tile-comes-away) fail for other reasons (fade 0.51s vs 0.5s, a renamed Spare field, tile out of view), not this undo count.

The app's undo was already right; the walk was stale. Since 500f13636 (2026-10-29) Dip to black goes on in two edits (Cmd-T, then Type), so five undos back out the insert, not four. insert-a-title-before-a-clip-walk now undoes five times and checks each state (dissolve, bare cut, cube, the insert's dissolve, title gone); it passes on the probe with 7 real window pictures. test.sh green. Commit b68cbac8d.
